    static int[] g = new int[N];
    static int[] b = new int[N];
    static int[] mp = new int[N];
    static int[] tot = new int[maxn];

    static int pow(int a, int b) {
        int ans = 1;
        for (; b > 0; b >>= 1, a = (int) ((long) a * a % mod)) {
            if (b % 2 == 1) ans = (int) ((long) ans * a % mod);

        return ans;

    static int inv(int a) {
        return pow(a, mod - 2);
    }

    static int fac(int x) {
        if (x == 0) return 1;
        return fac(x - 1) * x % mod;
    }

    static int C(int n, int m) {
        return fac(n) * inv(fac(m)) % mod * inv(fac(n - m)) % mod;
    }

    static int pc(int x) {
        return Integer.bitCount(x);

    static void fwt(int[] a, int lim) {
        if (lim == 0) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < lim; i++) {
            a[i] = (a[i] + a[i + lim]) % mod;
        }
        fwt(a, lim / 2);
        fwt(a + lim, lim / 2);
    }

    static void fwt2(int[] a, int lim) {
        if (lim == 0) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < lim; i++) {
            a[i] = (a[i] - a[i + lim] + mod) % mod;
        }
        fwt2(a, lim / 2);
        fwt2(a + lim, lim / 2);

        int n = in.nextInt();

                a[i][j] = in.nextInt();
                a[i][j] = (int) ((long) a[i][j] * inv(100) % mod);

            v[pc(i)].add(i);
            mp[i] = tot[pc(i)]++;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << (m * n)) - 1; i++) {
            int p = 1;
            int[] S = new int[3];
            for (int j = 0; j < m * n; j++) {
                p = (int) ((long) p * (i >> j & 1 ? b[j] : mod + 1 - b[j]) % mod);

            for (int j = 0; j < M * n; j++) {
                p = (int) ((long) p * (i >> j & 1 ? b[j + n * m] : mod + 1 - b[j + n * m]) % mod);

    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] array) {
        int n = array.length;
        int i = n - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && array[i + 1] <= array[i]) {
            i--;
        }
        if (i >= 0) {
            int j = n - 1;
            while (array[j] <= array[i]) {
                j--;
            }
            swap(array, i, j);
        }
        int left = i + 1;
        int right = n - 1;
        while (left < right) {
            swap(array, left, right);
            left++;
            right--;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static void swap(int[] array, int i, int j) {
        int temp = array[i];
        array[i] = array[j];
        array[j] = temp;
    }

    static void reduce(int x) {
